title: Climenko Fellow and Lecturer on Law
bio: Gemma Donofrio is a Climenko Fellow and Lecturer in Law at Harvard Law School. Her research focuses on reproductive rights and justice in private and public law. Her current project examines selective pronatalism in tort law and how tort law conceptualizes harm to reproductive autonomy. Her scholarship has appeared in the Virginia Law Review Online, […]
